integrity: The proof and embedded exact Q(sqrt(5)) certificate establish the claim to self-review; an independent audit has not been performed. Finite numerical trials are diagnostic only.
scientific_limitations: Only the regular undistorted icosidodecahedron and vertex-avoiding central planes. Nongeneric planes and off-center or other solids are outside the claim; historical priority is provisional.
title: Every generic central section of the icosidodecahedron is a dodecagon
